description: This is a Java Spring Boot controller class that manages CRUD operations for Person entities, communicating with clients via JSON DTOs.

classes.name: PersonController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller handling CRUD operations for Person entities, utilizing DTOs and mapping to internal models.

methods.name: getAllPersonsByPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of PersonDTO objects based on page and size parameters.

methods.name: addPerson
methods.description: Adds a new Person entity from the provided PersonDTO, returning a standardized response.

methods.name: getPersonByIdByUsingPathParam
methods.description: Fetches a Person by ID and returns its DTO representation.

methods.name: updatePerson
methods.description: Updates an existing Person identified by ID with data from PersonDTO, returns a response.

methods.name: deletePerson
methods.description: Deletes a Person by ID and returns an acknowledgment response.
